items: Retention depends on how fast and how personally you respond to feedback, because a quick, human reply to a complaint can make a guest more likely to return.
Most brands already collect feedback; the breakdown is the response workflow, where reviews go unanswered and survey data never reaches the stores.
Give local store managers the tools and authority to see feedback in real time, reply publicly or privately, and escalate serious issues to regional or corporate teams.
Start by mapping your response times by location, setting a standard response framework, automating triage and reply suggestions, and tracking how speed relates to return visits.
